title: A downhill snowboard racer with a new mountain every day
author: turnerskizzle
selftext:
Hey all. I've been working on Powder Kings, an arcade downhill snowboard racer. There's a new mountain every day, the same for everyone, with one leaderboard. You drop in, launch off kickers, race the ghost of yesterday's winner and try to make the board.

The project came from a few things: daily games blowing up, nostalgia for games like Downhill Domination on the PS2, and frustration with mobile games that look great until you play them, and are buried in ads even when they're good. I wanted a daily game that's actually fun to play, looks good and doesn't throw pop-ups at you.

How it's made:

* Claude Code for general coding 
* Higgsfield for concept sheets and the announcer's voice
* The rider was built and rigged in Blender by script through the Blender MCP. I tried Meshy first, but I've used Blender before and felt I had more control 
* ElevenLabs and Suno for sound effects and music
* Every run is saved as a ghost, so a replay studio can re-film any race from any camera and cut clips for socials. 

I started this project on the 21st so it's about 10 days old. Yesterday, 97 people rode it and dropped in 1,300+ times. Video is of a run I did about half an hour ago.

[powderkings.gg](https://powderkings.gg/?s=reddit): plays on phone or desktop, no sign-up.

What would make you come back the next day?

Thanks all! :)

replies.author: turnerskizzle
replies.body:
So a few ideas going forward, mainly aimed around giving people a reason to come back. Streaks, cosmetics, more variation in the runs, etc. Track wise is interesting, you want to keep it fast and competitive but you also want to keep it fresh. Toying with ideas around rails, gaps, other things like that.

This is all based off my own thoughts though. Ideally I’d get the player base, and shape it to what they need. If the base holds up, progress to something more robust

replies.author: turnerskizzle
replies.body: And I mean as far as the core game itself, it can all be refined. The mountain itself is very basic, same with trees etc.
